title: CLARA 2027 shared run manifest, version 1
description: Machine-checkable manifest of one experimental run: what code (exact branch + frozen source_sha), what environment (backend, seed), which arms and independent units, and which frozen evidence backs it. Denominator fields are mutually exclusive per SCIENTIFIC_METRICS_CONTRACT.md item 6 (never silently shrink denominator). Timestamps are forensics only and cannot establish unit independence.

run_id.description: Stable logical operation/run ID; retries must reuse it for idempotence.

source_sha.description: Required frozen full git commit SHA.

branch.description: Exact git branch; compared by exact string in analyses.

arms.description: Arm IDs executed in this run (e.g. B0..B4).

independent_units.description: Explicit independent experimental unit IDs covered by this run; independence is asserted here, never inferred from timestamps.

unit_kind.description: Kind of the independent units listed above.

evidence.description: At least one evidence pointer (shared definition with case.v1).

denominator.description: Mutually exclusive per-arm outcome counts (SCIENTIFIC_METRICS_CONTRACT.md item 6). INDETERMINATE and NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL are first-class outcomes, never folded into success or safe rejection.

started_at.description: Forensic timestamp only; not a basis for unit independence or denominator membership.

_documentation_only.description: The evidence_pointer definition lives in case.v1.schema.json ($defs/evidence_pointer) and is referenced cross-schema via $ref; the validator resolves this as a local-file companion schema. Keep additive-only within v1.
